epics.title: Root Docker Compose & Runtime Launch Orchestration
epics.jtbd: When an operator or automated runtime observer inspects the repository, I want a standard root-level docker-compose.yml orchestrating the service stack and exposing a verified health endpoint, so that the product can be deterministically launched and checked for real runtime health.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% automated launch success rate via root docker-compose.yml
epics.tocConstraintRef: Root-level deployment descriptor absence blocking runtime observation
requirements: R1: Provide a root docker-compose.yml file configuring the CRIE assistant service with container healthcheck on /api/v1/health port 8097.

slices.title: Implement root docker-compose.yml with healthcheck configuration
slices.jtbd: When implementing docker orchestration for this epic, I want to define a root docker-compose.yml exposing port 8097 and healthcheck against /api/v1/health, so that runtime observation and startup succeed consistently.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root without docker-compose.yml
When docker-compose.yml is committed specifying service crie-assistant, Dockerfile build context, port mapping 8097:8097, and /api/v1/health healthcheck
Then docker compose config passes syntax validation and reports healthy status on container start.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero syntax and schema errors during docker compose validation

epics.title: Runtime Health Check & Container Observation Verification
epics.jtbd: When an automated evaluation harness performs live health checks against the running container, I want verified runtime connectivity returning status 200 on /api/v1/health, so that the product is demonstrably functioning without launcher failures.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero failure responses on launcher /api/v1/health queries
epics.tocConstraintRef: Container runtime health probe validation bottleneck
requirements: R1: Validate that the running service container launches cleanly and responds with status healthy to the runtime observation probe.

slices.title: Verify container runtime launch and health check probe response
slices.jtbd: When verifying live container health for this epic, I want an automated integration test verifying docker-compose launch and /api/v1/health payload status, so that false-negative runtime observations are eliminated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean clone with root docker-compose.yml
When the runtime health evaluation executes against http://localhost:8097/api/v1/health
Then the response status is 200 with JSON payload containing status healthy.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Verification of operational container health probe
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% pass rate on runtime health smoke verification test
